text: The datetime module handles dates and times, which are surprisingly tricky to get right by hand.
datetime dot now gives you the current moment, with year, month, day, and time all accessible.
[chuckle] strftime formats a date into any string layout you like, using percent codes for each piece.
Here we produce a clean year-month-day and hour-minute stamp.
[sniff] timedelta represents a span of time, and you can add it to a date to move forward or backward.
Adding seven days to today lands us exactly one week later, with all the calendar math handled for you.
[sigh] Subtracting two dates gives you a timedelta back, telling you the gap between them.
So we instantly learn how many days remain until the end of the year.
[groan] Never do date math with raw numbers — datetime handles leap years, month lengths, and time zones correctly.
